answer: Each applicant must reserve a unique IPv6 /64 route for 20 epochs and answer eight beacon-timed path challenges per epoch from independent relays. Validators compare signed hop proofs; routes sharing the same upstream fingerprint are merged into one reward identity. A hollow tunnel cannot hide on a ledge when probes spiral across relays. Every extra fake therefore needs another routed /64 and 160 timely proofs, so 1,000 clones require 1,000 routes and 160,000 responses. Two missed rounds freeze the cluster for five epochs.
